annotations.title: Live promotion campaigns — the one bonus

description: Public. Rokha's promotion campaigns — the ONLY promotion bonus. Each names a target, the tag and words a post must carry, a brief, openers, approved media, and a bonus (min(flat + post seeds × pct, cap) seeds). A promoter's FIRST qualifying post of a UTC day that matches a live campaign claims that day's bonus — once a day across all campaigns; it counts only while the post itself earns on the Tailwind. Also returns the house media kit, the week's top posts and the standing briefs. Next: campaigns_me / campaign_claim (JWT).
